json_ld.description: The Oliva Elite 9" Chef’s Knife pairs a sleek, stealth blade with a gorgeous olive wood handle for razor-sharp slicing, dicing, and mincing. Hand-forged with Messermeister’s signature stealth blade—25% thinner and 10% lighter than traditional western chef’s knives—the lighter weight offers unmatched precision and reduced fatigue during long prep sessions. The elegant Mediterranean olive wood handle adds a natural, luxurious touch while providing a secure, ergonomic grip. Balanced, lightweight, and visually stunning, this blade does it all and looks good doing it.
json_ld.name: Oliva Elite Chef's Knife - 9"
